channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: This period delivered solid, concrete investment wins: DDEC's $7.4M Guaynabo logistics hub upgrade, a $100M Celligence/AngelAi fintech capital raise, Mays Ochoa's $3.7M chlorine plant, Envocore's $129M PRASA water-meter modernization contract, and the $860M DOE-backed Marahú solar-and-storage grid connection, alongside steady retail and franchise growth (Slim Chickens, Ichiban, Taco Maker, Five Below's planned 2027 entry) and Disney Cruise Line naming San Juan a new Caribbean home port. Real risks persist: a deepening drought has pushed the water utility back to a disputed cloud-seeding contract, San Juan airport traffic extended an 11-month decline even as regional competitors grow, and bankruptcy filings are tracking toward a post-2019 high.
